digest.component_or_area: Claude Code agent configuration / MCP tool loading
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring a ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction asymmetry against non-deferred tools like Bash/grep
The only available control for tool deferral is the global ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH environment variable (no per-tool or per-server setting exists), making selective non-deferral impossible

Loading all Serena tool schemas (~25 tools) costs a minimum +25,454 tokens on a single-MCP baseline and +63,852 tokens on a multi-server setup, but prevents the class of defect that caused pre-flight failures in prior epics
A tracked .claude/settings.json file with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false must be added to repo and git-ignore selectively negated to allow it while keeping .claude/ otherwise ignored
The setting change is configuration-only with a one-line revert and must be validated by tests asserting JSON validity, git tracking correctness, and documented token cost justification
